result.topic_en: A table of observations of the oscillations of an inverted pendulum (standing), with dates in 1830, 1831 and 1846, giving barometer reading, temperature in degrees Celsius, the time for 200 double oscillations, and the time for one double oscillation.

methods.what: Period of one double oscillation obtained by dividing the time of 200 double oscillations by 200 (or deriving it from a stated number of oscillations)
